universe: Existing codex_three.data.disclosures cached top-100 2024-2025 survey only
economic_rule: A specific adverse operating, financial-reporting, legal, or outlook fact shares one accession with unrelated routine administrative, compensation, governance, or meeting business, and is objectively less prominent in full filing order.
required: Specific actual adverse fact, not generic forward-looking boilerplate
Unrelated routine administrative, compensation, governance, or meeting disclosure in same accession
Full filing including relevant exhibits inspected

Adverse fact appears after at least one unrelated substantive routine item or in an exhibit following routine main-body disclosure, and is not highlighted in an earlier main-body heading or opening summary
excluded: Three or more taxonomy tags without content evidence
Related actions responding to the same adverse event
Routine Item 9.01 exhibit lists and signatures
Adverse fact is the lead substantive disclosure
Earnings report and associated guidance without unrelated administrative content
candidate_screen: Audit the entire adverse disclosure pool and its same-accession rows, including all plausible adverse plus administrative combinations regardless of tag count; retrieve full-source order before deciding any plausible combination.
controls: Source-reviewed adverse-only or prominently disclosed adverse filings from the same pool; record issue type and reasons rather than assuming random assignment.
